name: Cassia Bintan
short_description: Serviced apartments with beachfront living in Lagoi's Laguna Bintan Resort, with chef-ready kitchens, a beach club, and access to an 18-hole golf course.
ai_summary: Cassia Bintan is a serviced-apartment property offering beachfront living by the South China Sea, within the Laguna Bintan integrated resort in Lagoi. Apartments include chef-equipped kitchens for self-catering, and guests can socialise at the on-site beach club. As the newest addition to the Laguna Bintan resort, it shares access to the wider complex's facilities, including spas and an 18-hole golf course. Standard ALL elite benefits apply for Accor loyalty members.

core_facts.address: Jalan Teluk Berembang, Laguna Bintan Resort, Lagoi, 29155 Bintan, Indonesia
elite_benefits: Welcome drink for ALL Silver members and above, per programme terms
Room upgrades for ALL Diamond and Platinum members, subject to availability
Early check-in and late check-out for ALL Diamond members, subject to availability

pros: Serviced apartments with full kitchens — a genuine self-catering option distinct from a standard hotel room
Beachfront position within the Laguna Bintan integrated resort, with access to an 18-hole golf course and spas
